landscape.label: Rules to Know
landscape.title: Calabasas ADU rules to know

tiles.s: The most a city can require
State law controls if they conflict

landscape.speak: A few rules to know. A city can require no more than four-foot side and rear setbacks. A city has sixty days to act on a complete application. ADUs of seven hundred fifty square feet or less skip impact fees. And Calabasas's ADU ordinance is under state review, so state law controls where they conflict.
